Reconcile all 138 scandata leaves; explicitly exclude Color Card leaves 0 and 137 and align all 136 access leaves with PDF pages and DjVuXML OBJECTs.

Independently reconcile every source paragraph, line and word carrier; compare every scan correction, marginal heading, contents row, column assignment, paratext item, and explicit source disposition with its exact retained OCR carriers and coordinates.

Check the full 1-136 scan-page review coverage, one complete titled work in one TEI, front/body/back placement, seven chapter boundaries, index/bibliography/appended-matter boundaries, reading order, page labels, and PDF facsimile targets.

Preserve the empty line on page 2 paragraph 2 and all six zero-word pages; verify the cover and accession annotations, ambiguous handwriting, and barcode graphic receive their explicit source disposition without invented text.
Verify the seven-row page-13 table of contents, scan-grounded marginal headings, two-column structure on pages 126-132, page-134 preservation label, and page-136 printed barcode label/number.
Validate readable TEI against the bound TEI P5 XSD and candidate package schema.

Reject source-relevant mutations for altered correction-map binding, changed corrected text, omitted or duplicated headings, changed contents rows, broken column placement, omitted source-disposition notes, reordered or reworded pages, changed facsimile targets, moved back matter, missing empty carriers, and altered accounting.
Reproduce all five candidate members in separate clean processes from different working directories and compare exact bytes.
limitations: Every access-format scan page is covered by a visual-review entry, but the review is not a glyph-by-glyph transcription of all OCR words. Only scan-verified corrections are applied; untouched OCR may retain unobserved recognition errors.
Six no-word source pages are represented as explicit gaps; image-only text is not transcribed.

The OCR witness and correction map are common evidence for converter and oracle; the oracle independently checks their source-carrier bindings and output, but does not make an independent blind transcription of every printed word.
Rights clearance, human acceptance, integration, and publication are separate unresolved decisions.
